name: jeeksubcut
description: 以字幕驱动剪辑为起点、模块化可扩展的视频剪辑工作台

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:editor
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/engine packages/features/timeline packages/features/subtitles packages/features/audio packages/features/asr packages/features/export packages/features/preview
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node tools/check-boundaries.mjs && node --test tests/document.test.mjs tests/kernel.test.mjs tests/render.test.mjs tests/bootstrap.test.mjs tests/editor.test.mjs tests/frame-eval.test.mjs tests/visual-eval.test.mjs tests/move-plan.test.mjs tests/timeline.test.mjs tests/style-rules.test.mjs tests/asr-split.test.mjs tests/export-config.test.mjs tests/subtitle-io.test.mjs tests/subtitle-edit.test.mjs tests/subtitle-insert.test.mjs tests/font-catalog.test.mjs tests/audio-dsp.test.mjs tests/range-snap.test.mjs tests/enter-persistence.test.mjs tests/glyph-align-cache.test.mjs
